publicAssets.publicReads: Only same-origin /staff,/index.html,/favicon.svg and flat /assets files of explicitly allowed types. GET without cookies, manual redirects, exact response URL/status, 30s abort, streamed8MB/file and64MB total caps, <=2999assets; exclusive output.
publicAssets.closure: Staff/index bytes must match and remain unchanged at end. JS imports/Vite dependency strings, relative asset strings, CSS URLs/imports and SVG markup are recursively discovered. Built JS/CSS plus referenced favicon required. Only exact source Google stylesheet/preconnects are excluded; no original external font fetch.
publicAssets.references: Foreign, query-bearing, escaped/traversal, unsupported extension and unparsed supported resource references reject rather than produce a manifest. Same-document SVG/data references are skipped without network. The known native favicon is self-contained; source index font/favicon match the collector grammar.
publicAssets.falseGreenBoundary: This is a conservative static discovery manifest, not a proof of universal dynamic reference completeness. The live browser independently refuses every missing/unknown resource and checks each delivered asset byte hash, so a missed dynamic resource must fail the later proof.
